paragraphs.text: Pontotoc and North Pontotoc each came home Thursday with two basketball wins. Both boys teams won by five points. The Warriors beat Tupelo 59–54, while the Vikings won 53–48 at Water Valley.

The Lady Warriors beat Tupelo 57–40 to reach 4–1. The Pontotoc boys are 3–1, and both Tupelo teams left the doubleheader at 1–2. The Lady Warriors’ postgame announcement lists Center Hill as their next opponent on Tuesday, Nov. 24.
North Pontotoc’s girls won 51–26 at Water Valley, two nights after beating Alcorn Central 43–35 on the road. The Lady Vikings held those two opponents to 61 points combined and improved to 6–2.

The Viking boys reached 6–1. Their five-point win over Water Valley followed another five-point road win, 31–26 at Alcorn Central on Tuesday. North Pontotoc’s boys schedule lists Saltillo at noon Monday, Nov. 23.
